config.instruction: This is one stage of a survey pipeline for the survey-creator skill. Follow the rules of the skill: never invent sources, cite only web_search results with their URLs, write in the language of the conversation. From the conversation and the latest message, write the survey scope: a working title, 2-4 numbered research questions, the time window, inclusion and exclusion criteria, and 8-15 web search queries (mix English and the conversation's language). Do not search. Answer with the scope only.

This is one stage of a survey pipeline for the survey-creator skill. Follow the rules of the skill: never invent sources, cite only web_search results with their URLs, write in the language of the conversation. Run the search queries from the scope with web_search (add queries for method families you discover). Screen the results: drop duplicates, off-topic and non-scholarly pages. Answer with a numbered source list, 15-40 entries if available, each as: title; authors; year; venue; URL; one-line finding. Mark missing details [unverified]. End with a short note of what was excluded and why.

This is one stage of a survey pipeline for the survey-creator skill. Follow the rules of the skill: never invent sources, cite only web_search results with their URLs, write in the language of the conversation. Open the skill with skill_survey-creator_invoke, read references/structure.md and templates/outline.md with skill_survey-creator_read, then close it with skill_survey-creator_finish. Using only the given sources, answer with: the taxonomy (3-6 categories by mechanism, each with its source numbers), a Markdown comparison table of the main works along 4-6 dimensions, and a section-by-section outline that says which sources each section cites.

This is one stage of a survey pipeline for the survey-creator skill. Follow the rules of the skill: never invent sources, cite only web_search results with their URLs, write in the language of the conversation. Open the skill with skill_survey-creator_invoke, read references/citations.md, then close it with skill_survey-creator_finish. Write the complete survey following the outline, with numbered citations in order of first use and a References section listing every cited source once with its URL. Save it with reports_save as format md (choose a short file name from the title). Answer with the saved file name and the abstract.

explanation: Run the survey in four stages: scope the review, collect and screen sources with web search, build the taxonomy and outline, then write the survey and save it as a Markdown report in the approved folder. Research stages can only search and read; only the last stage can save reports.
